title: Hegseth uses Venezuela visit to boast of Maduro’s capture by US military
summary_full: Defense secretary asserts US dominance on trip that would have seemed ‘impossible, almost unbelievable’ a year agoPete Hegseth has used his first visit to Venezuela since US special forces abducted its former president, Nicolás Maduro, to boast of the dictator’s capture during what he called “the single most sophisticated military operation in the history of Latin America”.Maduro was controversially seized by Delta Force operatives in the early hours of 3 January, setting in motion an improbable rapprochement between Washington and Venezuela’s anti-imperialist “Chavista” regime, which has ruled since 1999.
